usdRate.note: Official rate 36.6243 córdobas per US dollar (2025 average). Trading Economics quoted 36.80 on 30 October 2026; the BCN site refused access, so its daily official rate could not be read.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: INIDE, Nota de prensa: Índice de Precios al Consumidor, julio 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Year-on-year CPI inflation 4.0% in July 2026 (0.64% a year earlier); core 2.84% (INIDE press note of 13 August 2026). The August and September notes were not found at INIDE; Trading Economics also shows July 2026 (4.0%) as the latest. World Bank 2025 average 2.08%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: INIDE CPI July 2026 4.0%; World Bank 2025 average 2.1% and higher rates in 2022-2023
inflation_projection.note: The córdoba moves little against the dollar and recent inflation has ranged from 2% to 4%, so planning uses 4%, close to the current rate.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de Nicaragua, Tasa de Referencia Monetaria, as reported by Trading Economics
policy_rate.note: Monetary reference rate (TRM) 5.75% in September 2026, unchanged from the previous reading; secondary source because the BCN site refused access.

savings_account_rate.note: The Banco Central de Nicaragua and SIBOIF sites could not be reached, and no other source for ordinary savings account rates was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: BCN deposit-rate statistics by term could not be reached (the site refused access).

fdr_1y_rate.note: BCN deposit-rate statistics by term could not be reached (the site refused access).

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate paid by commercial banks on deposits, 2.27% in 2025 (2.25% in 2024); BCN's own weighted rates could not be reached. Most deposits in Nicaragua are in US dollars.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate sold to individuals was found; government and central bank securities are sold through the stock exchange.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Yields on short-term central bank bills (Letras del BCN) could not be found because the BCN site refused access.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No published 5-year government bond yield was found; BCN and Ministry of Finance sites could not be reached.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No published 10-year government bond yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Nicaragua, corporate withholding taxes
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest paid to resident individuals or legal entities is subject to 15% withholding (page reviewed 4 August 2026); exemptions for small deposits, if any, were not confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Nicaragua, corporate withholding taxes
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No separate savings certificate exists; interest is generally subject to 15% withholding. Any exemption for government securities was not confirmed.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: FOGADE covers up to US$12,000 per depositor per member institution, principal plus interest, in córdobas or foreign currency; converted at 36.6243 córdobas per dollar (World Bank 2025).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate was found; the SIBOIF and BCN sites could not be reached.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No active local stock market; global equities in córdoba terms (córdoba closely tied to the US dollar: 36.62 in 2025, 36.80 in October 2026)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: global shares disappoint, leaving equities near after-tax deposit rates.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in dollar terms; after-tax average deposit 2.27% x 0.85 = 1.9% (World Bank FR.INR.DPST)
equity_return_base.note: Nicaragua's exchange trades mainly bonds, so equity is a global index fund in dollar terms; kept within 4 points of the after-tax safe rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run record in US dollars
equity_return_high.note: High case: global shares repeat their long-run record.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 3% lower in a year (Trading Economics)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold stays flat in dollars and the córdoba holds its value.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price trend (Trading Economics); córdoba closely tied to the dollar
gold_return_base.note: Base case: gold tracks long-run dollar inflation plus a little.

gold_return_high.note: High case: gold resumes its 2020s uptrend.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.27% less 15% tax (World Bank FR.INR.DPST; PwC)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.27% (World Bank); term deposits pay more than the all-deposit average
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: one-year term deposits after 15% tax, a little above the after-tax average of all deposits.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.27% (World Bank); longer deposits and government bonds
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits or government bonds bought through the stock exchange.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found; the SIBOIF site could not be reached.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No regulator or other non-company source with indicative term life premiums by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or other non-company source of private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 37.6% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.note: Medical costs usually rise faster than general prices; planning uses 5%, 1 point above projected inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: INIDE CPI July 2026: education division unchanged in the month, headline 4.0% year on year
goal_inflation_education.note: School fees step up once a year, usually faster than general prices; planning uses 5%.

life_expectancy.note: Men 72.5, women 77.6 (2024; latest World Bank figure, older than 2025).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from the 'life expectancy by current age' table for 2026 (UN WPP).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 8.6 in 2025 (World Bank), 13.7 in 2040 and 30.0 in 2065 (UN WPP medium variant).

retirement_age_default.note: The INSS old-age pension age (commonly 60) could not be confirmed: the INSS site refused access and the National Assembly legislation site could not be reached.

retirement_age_government.note: Public employees are covered by the INSS; the retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source that could be reached.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.27% less 15% tax (World Bank FR.INR.DPST)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.27% less 15% tax = 1.9% (World Bank FR.INR.DPST; PwC)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept at the after-tax average deposit rate, the only safe rate that could be sourced.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Longer term deposits and government bonds (World Bank FR.INR.DPST as floor)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer deposits or government bonds at higher yields.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax deposits about 1.5-2.5%; equity low case 2%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a mix of deposits and global equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half safe deposits and half global equity in dollar terms.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: equities do well and longer deposits pay more.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension amount was found; the INSS and government social programme sites could not be reached to confirm whether one exists.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found from a reachable official source.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code (Ley 185) provides a seniority indemnity on termination, but the National Assembly and Ministry of Labour sites could not be reached to confirm the days-per-year rule.

public_pension_scheme.note: The INSS contributory pension (Invalidez, Vejez y Muerte) rules could not be documented from an official source that could be reached.

tbond_5y.localName: Bonos de la República de Nicaragua
tbond_5y.note: Ministry of Finance bonds are traded through the stock exchange; yields could not be sourced.

tbond_10y.note: A regular 10-year domestic government bond could not be confirmed.

equity_fund.note: No diversified equity fund sold to retail savers in Nicaragua was confirmed; the local exchange trades mainly fixed income.

insuranceComplaints.note: Complaints about insurers go first to the insurer and then to SIBOIF; a dedicated complaints page could not be reached.
